use_of_test_split: THIRD use of the OpenOOD v1.5 ImageNet-1K test split (1st: CLAVIS, 2nd: CLAVIS-M c1). Run exactly once.
run_condition: only because the frozen candidate passed the pre-registered rule on dev1 and on its first dev2 look (iter2/dev2_looks.jsonl)
benchmark: OpenOOD v1.5 ImageNet-1K: ID test_imagenet (45,000); near = SSB-hard, NINCO; far = iNaturalist, Textures, OpenImage-O
tins: test_runs/default/<dataset>_seed<s>.npz: unchanged-upstream TINS (Codex's setup), per-dataset ID+OOD streams, stream orders s = 123..127 (the same runs as the paper's main table)

features.B14: test_eval/results/features.pt (stored by the first evaluation; also holds the CLIP zero-shot candidate sets)
features.L14: DINOv2 ViT-L/14 CLS features of exactly the same image list (paths in features.pt), standard eval preprocessing, extracted once by scripts/iter2_extract_test.py after this registration; its sha256 is written to test_eval/results/features_vitl14.sha256 at extraction

method: CLAVIS-M2 as frozen: per view (B/14, L/14) two-stage admission (candidate p_all <= 0.30, admit p_C <= 0.10), memory reset for every ID+OOD stream, score = S_final * p_t(B/14) * p_t(L/14)
primary_endpoints: near-average and far-average AUROC (upstream get_measures), mean over the 5 stream orders, compared with CLAVIS-M c1 recomputed on the same runs (paper: near 90.45, far 98.50) and TINS
secondary: per-dataset AUROC / FPR95 and SD over orders
class-level bootstrap 95% interval (B = 1000, seed 123) of CLAVIS-M2 minus CLAVIS-M c1 and minus TINS
not_evaluated: no other variant, threshold or backbone is evaluated on the test
